name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a multi-site SSL-enabled web server serving three virtual hosts with self-signed TLS certificates, host hardening (fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, SSH), and runtime secrets retrieval via CyberArk Conjur and OAuth2.

name: nginx_multisite
description: Ansible role migrated from the nginx-multisite Chef cookbook that installs and configures Nginx for multi-site SSL termination, host hardening, and AAP-injected credential management for Conjur, OAuth2, and API token integrations.
